Subject: POC blocked by nightly maintenance — need extension and keepsake credits

Hi Michael,

Quick note from the integration side: our nightly maintenance window triggered a cascade in the adapter that wiped some of the mapping work your team helped set up. Engineering has been able to reproduce the issue but the fix will take us 10–14 business days because we need a gated change in our infra. That pushes our demo and the rest of the POC timeline out substantially.

Given the delay we need two things to keep momentum with our exec sponsor:
- A 30–45 day extension of the trial window (we're currently scheduled to expire 6/30).
- A small sandbox credit to keep our engineers running longer while we validate the fix (we'd use it for end-to-end test runs).

I attached the integration log that shows the failure pattern. Can Redwood help here? We really want to finish the POC — execs are watching.

Thanks,
Tom

Internal only — quick thoughts:
- Recommend a 30-day extension first (less friction for bookkeeping). If AstraTech needs more we can extend another 15 days after a technical check-in.
- Recommend $2,000 in sandbox credits (covers extended e2e runs and a couple of stress tests).
- Business rationale: this is a time-sensitive exec-stake POC, high likelihood to convert given engagement. We should use a small currency of credits + extension to keep momentum rather than re-qualify later.

If Ben signs off on the $2k I can prep messaging and the extension form. Marissa, can you confirm Redwood engineering support bandwidth for one deep-dive session and a follow-up on the fix timeline?

Thanks — M
